warnings.heading: THIRD CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong easterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Kelantan until Tuesday, 10 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to small crafts, recreational sea activities and water sports. 2) WARNING ON SEA LEVEL RISE Sea level rise is expected over the waters of Kelantan until Tuesday, 10 November 2026. At risk of inundation of seawater over the coast. 3) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Sarawak • Western Sabah • Eastern Sabah until 9:00 AM; Tuesday, 10 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (THIRD CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds over 60 kmph with waves exceeding 4.5 metres are expected over the water of Northeastern Condore • Northwestern Reef North until Thursday, 12 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all coastal and shipping activities including workers on oil platforms. 2) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (SECOND CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 50 - 60 kmph with wave height up to 4.5 metres are expected over the waters of Condore • Northeastern and Southwestern parts of Reef North until Thursday, 12 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all shipping and coastal activities including fishing and ferry services. 3) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Palawan • Southeastern Reef North • Labuan • Layang-Layang • Samui • Northern Tioman until Thursday, 12 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to small crafts, recreational sea activities and water sports. 4) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Straits Of Melaka • Phuket • Samui • Tioman • Reef South • Reef North • Labuan • Layang-Layang • Condore • Bunguran • Palawan • Sulu until 9:00 AM; Tuesday, 10 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.

warnings.text: SECTION A: CONTINUOUS RAIN WARNING (SEVERE) Continuous heavy rain is expected to occur over the states of Kelantan (Bachok, Kota Bharu, Tumpat, Pasir Mas and Pasir Puteh) • Terengganu (Besut, Setiu, Dungun, Kemaman, Marang, Kuala Terengganu and Kuala Nerus) until Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
